_readme.title: Optional MCP Servers - Heavy Features
_readme.description: These servers are disabled by default to save ~65k tokens. Enable them when needed for specific tasks.
enableInstructions: Temporary enable: Set in .claude/settings.json enabledMcpjsonServers array
Permanent enable: Move server config to .mcp.json
Flag-based: Use custom flags like --with-ruv-swarm in commands
